meta.description: Anexa estatísticas de histórico de preço (30d) para flags de conteúdo.

parameters.query:
SELECT p.id, p.title, p.price, s.avg_price_30d, s.min_price_30d, s.max_price_30d, s.samples_30d,
  CASE
    WHEN s.samples_30d >= 3 AND p.price <= s.min_price_30d THEN 'MENOR_PRECO_REGISTRADO'
    WHEN s.avg_price_30d IS NOT NULL AND p.price <= s.avg_price_30d * 0.75 THEN 'MUITO_ABAIXO_DO_HISTORICO'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS price_story
FROM products p
JOIN v_product_price_stats s ON s.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.active AND p.opportunity_score >= COALESCE(($env.OPPORTUNITY_SCORE_THRESHOLD)::numeric, 70)
ORDER BY p.opportunity_score DESC
LIMIT 100;
